policy: Each pair compares the exact same source cases and actual occurrences. Shared layer/candidate judgments are reused, not independent trials. Intervals resample known paired case outcomes descriptively; unknown bounds show all unresolved pairs, not confidence limits. Error bootstrap units are annotated errors (mostly one per case), not independent population observations.
